answer: New identities face a proof-of-time gate: each fresh vertex in the trust graph must keep a beacon heartbeat alive for 72 hours before its first payout unlocks, and every extra identity from the same device cluster adds a further 48-hour delay. A sybil farmer running 100 fake agents waits through 200 days of staggered unlocks while paying about $0.40 daily per agent in upkeep, roughly $8,000, to reach rewards worth only $900 at current rates. If a genuine agent's haven goes offline briefly, a 6-hour grace window preserves its streak, while a second lapse inside 30 days resets the clock.
